label: Fixed diegetic observer
camera_rules: Define the in-world camera location, mount, field of view, obstruction, and recording properties.
Keep motion within the declared mount or mechanical range.
Treat the image as a story-world recording rather than a free external camera.
continuity_rules: Preserve mount position and field of view across time.
Keep obstructions and device artifacts spatially stable.
Record who can access or know the recorded information.
knowledge_policy: Apply the declared focalization and do not reveal information outside its scope unless the shot plan records a deliberate change.
